summary.what_changed: Committed three previously-untracked documents into docs/superpowers/artifacts/ (and a handoff prompt) capturing the CCE-183 payload audit: a census of ~30 unbounded agent payload/output fields across 12 dispatch sites, the measurement that MAX_ARG_STRLEN (131,072 B on ubuntu-latest, not ~1MB ARG_MAX) is the binding input ceiling, the 130,203-char jira_issues measurement from a failing run, and a five-item fix proposal centered on bounding once at dispatch_validated rather than per-field. Two corrections were applied to the captured docs versus the working-tree originals, verified against source.
summary.why: The documents existed only as untracked files in a working tree, and this repo's session-hygiene rule (born from the 2026-08-26 incident where a hook and test harness were permanently lost from an ephemeral location) requires such primary-source material to be committed to git. These docs are the primary source for CCE-183 and supply the root-cause measurement CCE-177 shipped on.

doc_targets.notes: Summarizes the CCE-183 payload/output field audit and the MAX_ARG_STRLEN finding now captured under docs/superpowers/artifacts/; treat as a decision/investigation record rather than evergreen architecture.

summary.notes: PR only adds artifact/handoff docs under docs/superpowers/ (not under the core lens root); doc_targets proposes a lens-facing digest page pointing at the newly committed audit rather than editing an existing architecture page, since no existing page in available_sections covers payload/dispatch bounding.
